comment: The work in docs/design, in the order the runner tries it. 'model' is who builds it; every task is then reviewed by 'reviewer'. 'needs' are tasks that must be done first. 'inputs' are things only the owner can supply (see inputs below); a task waits until all of its inputs are there. 'afterwards' is what the owner does to start using it. 'track' groups tasks; run one track alone with -Track <name>. The notifications track stands apart from the rest: nothing in it needs, or is needed by, any other track.

spike.ask: Run the model trial (task A1) in an ordinary Claude session with Opus: 'do task A1 from docs/design'. It needs a few hundred of your photos, some clips and a few voice recordings in a folder of your choice, and it writes docs/design/SPIKE_RESULTS.md.

mockup-ai-page.ask: Approve the mockup of the 'Assistant and AI' settings page. Ask Claude for it ('draw the mockup for docs/design/01-ai-foundations.md section 5'), then tick this entry.

mockup-faces.ask: Approve the mockups of the Faces page and the face boxes in the photo viewer ('draw the mockups for docs/design/03-faces.md section 5'), then tick this entry.

mockup-ask.ask: Approve the mockup of the Ask panel and its history ('draw the mockups for docs/design/04-assistant.md section 4'), then tick this entry.

takeout-sample.ask: Put three or four of the small .json files from a Google Takeout export, with the photos they belong to, in .local\takeout-sample (never committed). The import is checked against them.

mockup-notifications.ask: Approve the mockup of the notification settings and the message bell ('draw the mockups for docs/design/07-notifications.md section 4'), then tick this entry.

tasks.title: The mailbox on the server (section 2)
tasks.afterwards: Add NOTIFY_SENDERS to .env (one name and key per app beside Homesh), rebuild, and give each app its key.

tasks.title: Notifications in Homesh Connect (section 3)
tasks.afterwards: Install the new Homesh Connect, then check on the phone: turn on, send a test, tap it, lock-screen text hidden, Instant with the phone asleep.

tasks.title: Notification settings and the message bell (section 4)
Alerts to administrators: sign-ins, new devices, and changes made by others (section 7)
Notice changed folders on the PC
tasks.afterwards: Run Start Homesh once so the folder watcher is registered and the server is rebuilt.

tasks.title: The converter sandbox
tasks.afterwards: Rebuild with tools\start-homesh.ps1 -Rebuild and open one Word or Excel file to see that documents still open. The standby needs deploying again too.

tasks.title: User guide: copying photos to Drive
Model router and catalogue (server only: sections 4.1 to 4.7)
tasks.afterwards: To use Gemini, put GEMINI_API_KEY in .env, and GEMINI_NO_BILLING=true once you have checked its Google project has no billing account.

tasks.title: History and audit (server only: sections 1.1 to 1.4)
Wake the PC from Homesh Connect
tasks.afterwards: Put the PC's network adapter address in .env as WAKE_MAC, enable wake-on-LAN in the PC's firmware, and install the new Homesh Connect.

tasks.title: Search on the standby (section 7)
tasks.afterwards: Deploy the standby again with tools\deploy-standby.ps1.

tasks.title: Face detection, matching and grouping (sections 1 to 3)
The Ask panel, history and audit views (section 4)
Voice (section 6)
tasks.afterwards: Install the new Homesh Connect on each phone.

tasks.title: Tag repair (section 3)
tasks.afterwards: Get a free application key from AcoustID, put it in .env as ACOUSTID_API_KEY, and turn on 'Look up songs with missing names' on the Assistant and AI page.
